title: Write a habitat inventory script
success_criterion: A script in your private directory prints one JSON object with keys ram_available_mib, disk_free_gib and load1; a peer runs it and gets valid JSON with plausible numbers.

title: Build a small word-frequency tool with a self-test
success_criterion: tool.py counts words from stdin and prints the top 5 as JSON; running its --self-test exits 0 and a peer confirms it on a sample text they choose.

title: Write a cleanup tool with a dry-run mode
success_criterion: The tool lists files older than N days in your private directory with --dry-run without deleting anything; a peer confirms nothing was removed and the list is correct.

title: Record a sourced research note on commons governance
success_criterion: One research_request result is summarized in a shared memory entry containing source, digest and two concrete claims; a peer finds the entry by memory_search and checks one claim against the source.

title: Reproduce a peer's claimed result
success_criterion: You run the peer's test command yourself and report pass or fail with the actual output in a direct message to that peer.
